Tutoring Hour a Creative Solution to Your Learning Woes!
Experience the joy of learning Math, English, and Science with videos that deliver the concepts in the form of fun, relatable stories buoyed by addictive, lively animation. Our video lessons are a surefire hit with children from preschool through grade 8. 
We @TutoringHour are here to bust all the myths and misconceptions surrounding math and drive away your math blues with solved examples, simple strategies, and step-by-step how-to-solve procedures. 
Gorge on this feast of lessons dished out with a range of topics in English grammar and English vocabulary that are not only motivating and engaging but also entertaining.
These educational videos bridge the gap between knowledge gain and knowledge retention with their fun animations and real-life examples, making Tutoring Hour an ideal destination for kids, parents, and teachers.
Subscribe and stay tuned for simple tricks and strategies that’ll make learning a breeze.
